This should take me about like ten to fifteen minutes and then I'll get you the estimate. Sounds good.' — No explicit time-boxed ask with 'does that sound good' framing at the true opening; rushed into probing.
evidence_quotes.discovery_basics: Name: Tony Dean ✓ | Date: October 22 ✓ | Route: current address to Grandberry ✓ | Size: 3916 sq ft ✓
evidence_quotes.walkthrough_branch: Jules correctly identified ≥1800 sq ft move (3916 sq ft) and offered virtual walkthrough: 'for a home the size it would be best estimated if we can do a video call. Are you available for that right now or anytime today?' Scheduled for 1:00 PM same day.
evidence_quotes.their_agenda: Jules: 'Aside from the quote in general, do you have any specific concerns about your upcoming move?' Asked AFTER customer had already mentioned packing and destination (probing had begun). Customer answered 'No.'
evidence_quotes.logistics_details_gathered: Confirmed: property type (home), square footage (3916), partial furniture exclusion mentioned ('we're not taking all the furniture'). Did NOT gather: floor/stories, specific room count, walking distance to truck, additional rooms, special considerations details, additional stops. ~2 of 7 items.
evidence_quotes.packing_services_offered: Not explicitly offered as a probing question. Customer stated 'you all are going to be doing packing' (customer initiated), Jules acknowledged but did not ask if they wanted it.
evidence_quotes.estimate_anchor: No estimate given; call properly routed to walkthrough before pricing
evidence_quotes.pricing_framing: No pricing discussed; N/A for walkthrough-scheduler
evidence_quotes.booking_confirmed: Partial — time (1:00 PM today) and phone number (implied via text link) confirmed. Missing: explicit arrival window, crew size, delivery address re-confirmed for clarity, crew notes on customer concerns. Jules stated 'I'll text you a link that you can join at 1:00 today.' Clean walkthrough handoff achieved.

top_strength: Jules correctly identified the 3,916 sq ft move as requiring a virtual walkthrough, offered it at the right moment (Section 1), and cleanly scheduled it without abandoning the pitch or getting cut off—exemplary walkthrough-router execution.
coaching_note: Move 'Their Agenda' (any specific concerns?) to the very beginning of discovery, before discussing logistics—it was asked after probing had already started, which violates the sequencing rule.
